name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup on one map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Connect by drawing a line, with preview and Undo; install, update and sign in from each box's menu. New in 1.0: Ask AI (say what you want, get checked proposals), update badges with Update with AI, signed data-only add-ons, rules for what may be done, dictation, llama.cpp tuning. 8 languages.
